claims.explanation: Rivaroxaban is a factor Xa (F10) inhibitor, and its antiproliferative/cytotoxic selectivity in this screen most plausibly reflects dependence on coagulation-factor signaling rather than a general cytotoxic effect. The pattern of sensitive lines is enriched for TP53-mutant, KRAS/BRAF-mutant epithelial tumors with high proliferative/coagulation pathway activity, while resistant lines include several with intact or alternative survival signaling. The most predictive features are therefore expression of F10 and coagulation-pathway components plus mutation of TP53, which together may sensitize cells to factor Xa inhibition.
